plain_description.what: Two existing independent solves by the reference model were compared, to see whether a majority over more samples could raise its accuracy on hard questions. No calls were made.
plain_description.why: It decides whether a paid third sample is worth buying to strengthen the judge's reference.
plain_description.information: Large disagreement would mean voting could help. High agreement would mean it cannot. Result: done. The two solves agree 94% of the time, so a majority of 3 would gain about nothing. Only a different family of solver could raise the ceiling. The paid test was not run. Older p2dca data family: history, not evidence.
